result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the bottom navigation bar is missing the icon for the 'Orders' tab, breaking the visual consistency of the tab bar. There are also minor inconsistencies in the favorite (heart) button treatment across restaurant cards and low-contrast search placeholder text. Carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' all have icons. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look broken/unloaded, and it also misaligns the label baseline relative to the other tabs.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing 'Orders' icon (e.g., a receipt/bag outline) in the same size, stroke weight, and inactive gray color as the other tabs, and ensure all labels share the same vertical position.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card the heart sits directly on the image with no backdrop, while on the pizza card below it has a dark circular background. This makes the control harder to see on lighter imagery and looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent semi-transparent dark circular scrim behind the heart icon on all restaurant card images so the affordance is equally visible and visually uniform.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is rendered in a very light gray on a light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (target at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background) or use a darker gray tone while keeping it distinguishable from entered text.
